extraction.notes: Current-quarter (three months ended March 31, 2025) column of Attachment 2. Starting line is net income attributable to common stockholders ($75,514), not UDR Inc. net income of $76,720 in Attachment 14(B); the $1,206 difference equals the Series E preferred distribution. Series E distribution is added back to reach diluted FFO ($208,292), which is the base for FFO as Adjusted and AFFO; it is recorded as an 'other' FFO adjustment. Basic FFO subtotal of $207,086 is an intermediate line and is reconciled via the listed adjustments. All subtotals tie: 207,086 + 1,206 = 208,292; 208,292 + 10,779 = 219,071; 219,071 - 18,405 = 200,666. Per-share checks: 208,292/357,432 = 0.58; 219,071/357,432 = 0.61; 200,666/357,432 = 0.56. AFFO deducts recurring capex, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null.
